search.snippet: A mixed dragon is an intermediate step in making a drunk dragon. It is created by clicking the Pour option on a mixed dragon with a cocktail glass in your inventory, requiring level 32 Cooking. The mixed dragon needs to be garnished with pineapple chunks and a pot of cream to become the next step.
